name: blocksweep
title: blocksweep
blurb: paste a Bluesky list link, review the full membership, sign in, and bulk-block everyone on it with one confirm — real app.bsky.graph.block records, not a subscribe. @moll.dev wondered aloud about blocking all the subscribers of a blocklist that's being used against people; atproto has no public index of who's subscribed to a list (that'd need scanning every repo on the network), so this sweeps the list's actual, public membership instead — the closest real thing to build.
